concept: Aurora: 6 copies across 3 AZs and fast failover
tests: Choosing a managed relational DB with automatic replication across three AZs, fast failover and better performance than standard MySQL.
expected: Amazon Aurora MySQL-compatible: 6 copies of data across 3 AZs, automatic fast failover, higher throughput than MySQL. Triggers: "three AZs", "better than standard MySQL", "relational".
why_not: RDS Single-AZ — no failover; DynamoDB — NoSQL; Redshift — analytics warehouse, not OLTP.
